segments.text: India just launched three sovereign AI
models and one of them is beating Deep
Seek and Google Gemini on key
benchmarks. Follow full disclosure and
I'll break this down for you. At the
India AI impact summit, three Indian AI
companies unveiled models designed to be
trained, deployed, and governed entirely
within India. First, Serum AI launched
two large language models, a 30 billion
parameter model and a 105 billion
parameter model. The 105B model is
reportedly matching or outperforming
DeepSeek V3 and Google Gemini Flash on
several benchmarks. Second, Gani AI
unveiled Vajna TTS, a textto-spech model
that can clone human voices across 12
Indian languages using under 10 seconds
of reference audio. Third, Bhat Jen, an
IIT Bombayled consortium, launched a 17
billion parameter multilingual model
optimized for Indic languages. It's open
source and designed for governance,
healthcare, agriculture, and enterprise
use cases. What are your thoughts on
sovereign AI?
